rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for oxygen gas, including oxygen administered to a patient.

example.english: The doctor told me to wear an oxygen mask.
example.jyutping: ji1 saang1 giu3 ngo5 daai3 zyu6 joeng5 hei3 zaau3

rows.note: Use this specifically when referring to oxygen as a chemical element rather than to the gas in ordinary use.

example.english: The chemical element oxygen is the eighth element in the periodic table.
example.traditional: 氧係元素週期表入面嘅第八號元素。
example.jyutping: joeng5 hai6 jyun4 sou3 zau1 kei4 biu2 jap6 min6 ge3 dai6 baat3 hou6 jyun4 sou3
